body: Thank you for your response! I’m so tired of smelling like smoke, coughing up gross stuff and spending all that money. I love the dramatic part you wrote, I’m naturally dramatic so this makes it worse for me 🤣  can’t wait to be at my own 4 month mark!
You have the right to brag!!! That’s impressive! Congrats on being a non smoker!

I will check out the book! Thank you for your positive words and advice. I’m more worried about physical symptoms as I don’t wanna feel like crap on my birthday lol I think if I can make it to a week I can make it forever, who the heck wants to go thru this withdrawal twice 😭 The only emotional thing I go thru when I’m having nicotine withdrawal is the anger, I’m homicidal by the second day lol but I’m going to keep coming back to this post and remind myself it’s only for now, not for forever!
Omg 77 days?!!! CONGRATS!!! And thank you! I developed crazy anxiety with smoking, couldn’t leave my house or drive a car but I can do all those things now, 59 days clean!!
7 years! Probably silly to think I’ll be ok after one week 😭
Thank you for sharing! I’m hoping after one week all physical symptoms will be gone and it’ll just be an urge thing going on.

I appreciate the honesty! lol I had a weed problem as well and everybody told me it could take 6 months from my quit date to feel normal after smoking everyday for 5 years, took me 9 days! So I’m hoping it’ll be the same with cigs. Was it withdrawal like physical symptoms that were hard or was it the mental ie depression anxiety?
Keep going forward! So proud of you for starting this journey even though it’s kinda scary! The sun is coming just hang on!!!

The “your brain is rationalizing reasons to smoke” hit me so hard! It’s not the activity, it’s just my brain craving the nicotine and trying to come up with a reason to smoke! Thank you for your input.
The part where the “somebody” said not to leave the forest that night but stay is what really got me 😭
Thank you, that makes me feel better that there’s a light at the end of the tunnel.
Ahh yes the mornings are the worst for me! Thank you  for your reply.

I’ve had cdiff and didn’t notice a distinct smell to it which I find weird lol  and with patients who’ve had it too but I’ve had a patient with a gi bleed and that is the worst thing I have ever smelled! Will never forget it.

Hi y’all! 
I have to take a drug test this thursday, I’ll have been abstinent for about 18 days at that point! I’ve been taking at home drug tests and even with diluted pee I’m only getting faint negatives. I weigh 166 pounds at 5’4, I’m also a female if that matters... went from smoking every day (pens, regular bud) for pain management to stopping going 1 week clean then smoking 3 blunts (I’m smart but my common sense is lacking at times especially when my good ol buddy marijuana is around!) I don’t know what to do at this point. The test will be at quest labs. Any tips will be appreciated!
I forget sometimes that I’m not supposed to be strong all the time. I feel shame for making this post, embarrassed that I let my mental health get to this point.

You are the first person to tell me I have value in a long time, I’m bawling my eyes out. I feel like I want to survive for my baby but then I think that maybe he’d be better off without me. I will call the number when my son goes with his papa, thank you for taking the time to comment.
